proof_scope: The /debugger walkthrough feature: the agent authors a debugger.walkthrough.v1 spec and the driver walks the live VS Code debugger through its stops, pausing at each named line, narrating, and showing the real paused variable state. Capability-gated on a trusted live VS Code bridge; fails closed and rejects malformed specs.

claims.proves: vscode_walkthrough.py drives the live debugger through an ordered spec (main.py:20 first=6 -> tally.py:12 seen=[1] -> main.py:21 second=36) with matching narration, fails closed when no bridge answers, and rejects a non-walkthrough spec
claims.does_not_prove: spoken/voice narration, or human interactive Q&A during the walkthrough

cases.name: live-walkthrough-review
cases.description: Walk the live debugger through the three stops of the variable_state review spec, asserting each stop's captured state matches the spec's expectations. Requires DEBUGGER_VSCODE_WORKSPACE at an open+trusted VS Code folder; otherwise BLOCKED.
command: set -uo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; WS="${DEBUGGER_VSCODE_WORKSPACE:-}"; if [ -z "$WS" ]; then WS="$(mktemp -d)"; cp ../scenarios/variable_state/*.py "$WS/"; fi; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/vscode_walkthrough.py --spec ../scenarios/variable_state/walkthrough.review.json --workspace "$WS" --wait-seconds 30

cases.name: fails-closed-without-live-bridge
cases.description: With a workspace that is not open in VS Code, the walkthrough must fail closed (BRIDGE_BLOCKED, exit 3) rather than hang or fabricate a tour.
command: set -uo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; WS="$(mktemp -d)"; cp ../scenarios/variable_state/*.py "$WS/"; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/vscode_walkthrough.py --spec ../scenarios/variable_state/walkthrough.review.json --workspace "$WS" --wait-seconds 6

cases.name: rejects-malformed-spec
cases.description: A spec that is not a debugger.walkthrough.v1 object is rejected before any debugging, deterministically.
command: set -uo pipefail; export UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT="${UV_PROJECT_ENVIRONMENT:-/mnt/storage12tb/skills/debugger/.venv}"; export UV_LINK_MODE=copy; BAD="$(mktemp).json"; printf '{"schema":"nope"}' > "$BAD"; uv run --project .. python ../scripts/vscode_walkthrough.py --spec "$BAD" --workspace "$(mktemp -d)"
